Parker Daniel Queenan (born November 23, 2001) is an American actor and filmmaker. He is known for his roles in the Nickelodeon anthology Are You Afraid of the Dark? (2021) and the NBC drama Found (2025).
Early life
Queenan grew up in Pleasanton in Alameda County, California. He attended Village Hills Elementary School and Pleasanton Middle School. His parents are Angi and Kevin. He moved to Los Angeles with his aunt for his career, where he enrolled in independent study.
Career
Queenan began his career creating short films. He received Awards of Merit for Business as Usual at the 2016 Accolade Global Film Competition and Beyond Conscious at the 2017 Indie Fest respectively. He made his television debut with a guest role as Reed in the 2018 Andi Mack episode "Cookie Monster", which aired on Disney Channel. Alongside Ally Ioannides, he starred in the short film Red, which screened at the Cannes Short Film Corner.
Queenan had his first main role as Connor Stevens in the season season of the Are You Afraid of the Dark? anthology revival, which aired on Nickelodeon in 2021. Queenan returned to filmmaking with his 2023 short film Artifice, which was nominated for the Visionary Award at Burbank International Film Festival. He made a guest appearance in a 2024 episode of the ABC series 9-1-1.
In 2025, Queenan joined the cast of the NBC procedural drama Found for its second season as Jamie.
Filmography

*The Sound of Silence (2015) – director, writer
*The Depiction (2015) – director, writer
*The Recollection (2016) – director
*Desolate (2016) – director, writer
*Pull the Pin (2016) – director, writer
*Business as Usual (2016) – director, writer, cinematographer, composer
*Beyond Conscious (2017) – director, writer, cinematographer, producer
* Artifice (2023) – director, writer
